description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PasswordStrengthService in the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup methods and multiple test cases to validate password policies, enforcement requests, URL validation, and user password saving functionalities within the authentication service module.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the functionalities of PasswordStrengthService, including password policy checks, enforce requests logging, URL validation, username retrieval by reset code, and enforcing password saving.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of PasswordStrengthService, setting up configuration path, populating test data from a YAML fixture, and mocking core services required for testing.

methods.name: testGetEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getEnforcePasswordDao method returns an instance of EnforcePasswordDao.

methods.name: testCheckPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Tests password policy validation messages for different password inputs to ensure policies are correctly enforced.

methods.name: testIsValidPassword
methods.description: Checks the password validation method to ensure it correctly identifies valid and invalid passwords based on strength requirements.

methods.name: testLogPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Validates that the password enforcement request logging functions correctly and returns a string result.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Ensures that URL validation logic permits only valid URLs based on timestamp and code criteria.

methods.name: testGetUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Verifies that the system can accurately retrieve usernames from reset codes.

methods.name: testSaveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Tests the functionality for saving an enforced password for a user, checking both success and failure conditions.
